In the past few months, I’ve seen people disconnecting frequently, often with more than 10 people in the same instance losing connection simultaneously. I’ve also been experiencing this issue more myself, even while using a robust router, a stable connection with low internal network traffic, 800mb bandwidth, and a high-end machine. This clearly shows that the problem is not on the client’s side, but rather with VRChat’s servers.

It doesn’t make sense for a company focused on a community-driven game to ignore such a large community like the Brazilian one.

I hope they can give the proper attention to this issue, as it affects an entire community.

O VRChat tem enfrentado um problema recorrente de desconexões aleatórias, afetando jogadores de diferentes regiões e provedores. Como criador de conteúdo no TikTok, isso impacta diretamente minha experiência e a de muitos outros que dependem de uma conexão estável para interagir e criar. Enquanto outros jogos rodam sem dificuldades, no VRChat somos constantemente interrompidos por esses erros frustrantes. A sensação de ver tudo congelar e depois acelerar de repente quebra completamente a imersão. Esse não é um problema isolado, e muitos jogadores estão sendo afetados. Espero que a equipe tome medidas para resolver isso, pois o crescimento do VRChat depende de uma experiência estável e confiável.   BRASIL+

Mano, pior que eu tenho um problema MUITO estranho no Vrchat por conta da conexão, e já tentei de inúmeras vezes resolver essa parada. 

É sempre um estress ter que ficar adivinhando em que momento vou poder jogar vr sem ele se bugar todinho por conta da conexão. 

Alguns mundo simplesmente do nada aparecem como não compatível com a minha plataforma, SENDO QUE EU SOU DESKTOP. 

Recentemente começou a dá bastante erro em avatares, sem sentido algum, e as vezes aparece um texto "server processing" no loanding dos avatares. 

Além disso, vive duplicando amizades e mapas, ou só simplesmente fazendo sumir. Os convites e solicitações tem um delay absurdo.

E parece que esse problema me ocorre a cada 5 meses. 

Não sei mais qual magia lançar pra fazer esse jogo voltar a funcionar ksksks

jogo o jogo a 2 anos e é impressionante a quantidade de vezes que eu caia do mapa por conta da conexão, tinha dias que era quase impossível jogar o jogo! recentemente isso vem acontecendo com bastante frequência comigo e com outras pessoas que eu converso dentro do jogo, muitas vezes eu fiquei caindo diversas vezes no VrChat por conta da conexão, e foram tantas vezes que cheguei a perder a paciência com o jogo e desistia de jogar e só tentava de novo no dia seguinte.

eu imploro que resolvam esse problema, porque é uma quantidade grande de pessoas que infelizmente então passando por esse problema e sinceramente é bem irritante não poder jogar o jogo por conta da conexão dos servidores.

I hope this gets resolved. I love playing VRChat, but lately, I’ve been getting disconnected so often that I was forced to spend money on a VPN and Virtual Desktop to fix this issue. On top of that, I have to spend around $8 monthly just to keep the VPN running. It’s frustrating to have high ping and keep getting disconnected, especially since I spend around $40 on 1GB of internet, and due to the lack of local servers in Brazil, I can’t even enjoy a simple gameplay session.

Additionally, I currently use VRPlus. $10 might be cheap for people earning in euros or dollars, but for Brazilians, it’s quite a lot. I believe that if the price were reduced to $4.99, it would be much fairer, allowing people who already subscribe to maintain their membership for much longer and encouraging many more Brazilian players to support the game they love. We all hope for some recognition from the VRChat team.
Jogo a 7 anos e hoje faço lives todos os dias no tiktok, estou tendo o mesmo problema, acontece pelo menos 1 vez em todas a lives que faço.

I've also been having this quite a bit this year.

I'm from the UK on 2 Gig fiber up and down. We monitor our own connection status and I can confirm there is no drops going on.

The process is the same as what people above me had said. People freeze in the instance then a message pops up with "Connection was terminated by the host" then I rejoin the instance fine. The 2nd and 3rd time the exact same thing happens and normally after the 3rd time VRC will just hard crash.
What bothers me is that this bug is ruining the way VRChat is played, and no developer even says, "Hey, we're looking into it" or points out any issues. It's simply a matter of negligence.

details:
My Experience:

We here in Brazil have been forced to use external resources or even endure absurd connection errors that come exclusively from VRChat. I play more than 30 different games and have no connection issues with any of them.

Description:

However, for over three months now, VRChat has been experiencing an extremely frustrating issue that has even made me stop playing for a few days due to how annoying it is. Randomly, the game disconnects. My friends and I get disconnected in a way where we can still move and walk around the world, but everyone appears frozen. After a few seconds, everything speeds up, and then we can play normally again—until the next disconnect, which can happen anywhere between 1 hour and 2 minutes later.

This issue affects people from different regions and with different internet providers. In some cases, only a few players get disconnected while others remain in the world without any issues.

When the game fails to reconnect properly, it kicks you from the instance and reconnects automatically.

Conclusion:

The number of people affected by this issue is not small, and I would really like to see a solution to such a bothersome problem. I love seeing VRChat grow and improve, and I hope this issue gets addressed soon.
